messages:
meera: Quick follow-up from the Mercury customer postmortem. Short summary: transient peering flap + on-prem cache race led to tenant traffic drifting to the default route. I pulled the actionable items into a tracker and sketched owners below. Link: https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/mercury-2026
ops-bot: Follow-up created: TRACK-4129 (mercury-remediate) — priority: P2 — due: 2 weeks
raj: I'll own the peering-side fix. Plan: add idempotent peering reconcile and a route-check assertion. Expect PR + staging deploy by Wed. Blocker: need confirmation of customer's AS prep window.
tomas: I'll take the cache race. Preliminary cause is concurrent kv_apply + shard-rebalance under high connection churn. Repro on onprem-sim w/ 12k clients. Estimate: 3 days to patch + tests.
nina: I'll coordinate customer ops and craft the pre/post-change notice. Also will ask for their peering maintenance windows and edge firewall maintenance SLA. Ticket: CUST-10588.
meera: Owner list: peering reconciler -> @raj (TRACK-4129/CHG-4410), cache race -> @tomas (POST-4129/PR forthcoming), customer comms -> @nina (CUST-10588). Please add exact calendar dates by EOD and flag any infra capacity needs.
raj: Noted. Customer allowed windows: Mon/Fri 01:00-05:00 JST. I'll aim for Fri 02:00 JST. Will open CHG-4410 and include rollback steps.
tomas: Running a longer soak now. If repro holds, I'll open runtime PR: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/1299 and attach unit + integration tests.
nina: Draft ready; holding until CHG slot confirmed. Also added a temporary mitigation: reduce connection fanout at the edge for affected tenant during the window.
meera: Adding monitoring to catch silent regressions: alert on "tenant_route_switch" count > 5/min and KV inconsistency metric. Will add to POST-4129.
raj: Also adding a config assertion to the peering controller: refuse apply if peer routes overlap unexpectedly.
tomas: Adding integration coverage for shard-alignment during cache rebuilds to avoid silent divergence.
ops-bot: Linked issues: TRACK-4129, CHG-4410, POST-4129, CUST-10588 — https://tracker.redwood.com/TRACK-4129
meera: Proposed timeline: raj change -> Fri night (JST), tomas staging deploy -> Tue, customer comms -> within 12h of scheduling. If that works I'll mark immediate follow-ups closed and start a biweekly incident trends sync.
raj: Confirmed CHG-4410 scheduled Fri 02:00 JST, rollback plan included.
tomas: Staging deploy targeted Tue 09:00 UTC. I'll post PR when tests pass.
nina: Will send customer notice 6 hours before window and schedule post-change validation call.
meera: Thanks team. I'll run the first trends sync in two weeks. Please add any additional postmortem notes or test artifacts to TRACK-4129. :white_check_mark:
raj: :white_check_mark:
tomas: :white_check_mark:
